Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: More chimes in short sessions
Body: Chimes can now come as close as 1.2 seconds apart.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Added final end charm
Body: Added one final charm that sounds different so users know for sure its ending.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Soft start
Body: First chime now starts soft and goes to full volume halfway through.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Fixed the calculations
Body: Instead of having fixed time, the chimes are now calculated by halving whatever time is left until there are less than 1.5 seconds apart.

Author: SoleyatRmit
Subject: Added closing in chimes
Body: Chimes ring at a half, three quarters, seven eighths and fifteen sixteenths of the session, so they come closer together as the end nears. Claude helped a lot with this.
